label_source: Measured body outcome in the same 500 ms window: yaw change and path length
features: sqrt spikes; log1p positive/negative voltage area; normalized to 500 ms
feature_rule: All annotated sensory classes and every registered input cell excluded; training-active internal cells only
readout: sqrt spike counts and log1p voltage areas -> Ridge alpha=10
thresholds_from: Training split quantiles only, before any validation or test window is scored
revision_history: v1 (fixed 5 deg / 0.5 mm discrete rules): zero qualified labels on retinal-axes-v3; right turns absent from validation and "forward" covered ~80% of windows.
v2 (discrete labels, training-quantile thresholds): move:active/move:still qualified on retinal-axes-v3, nothing qualified on conspecific-v4.
v3 (continuous vector regression, this mode): rules fixed before the conspecific-v5 corpus exists.
explicit_non_claims: The body is driven by recorded neural activity through a pinned engineering controller; part of what is learned is that controller map.
A label is a measured movement, not a validated internal intention or a decoded command.
No window is labelled from the human sentence, the scene, the planned stimulus or the recorded motor commands.

qualification.turn: r(predicted, measured yaw) >= turn_r_min over validation AND sign agreement >= turn_sign_min over validation windows whose |measured yaw| exceeds the training-split turn quantile
qualification.move: r(predicted, measured path) >= move_r_min AND a threshold at the training median of path reaches >= move_precision and >= move_recall on validation

speech: Only qualified components are spoken; the other abstains.
